sections.text_helper: Section 8.4.2 "Internal regulator" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 226.
sections.section_content:
The devices embed an LDO regulator to provide the VCORE supply for digital peripherals,
SRAMs, and embedded flash memory. The LDO generates this voltage on VCAP, with a
total external capacitance of 2.2μF (typical). The LDO regulator is always enabled in Run
mode and Stop mode, generating Vcore at 1.2V in Run and Stop 0 mode and at 0.95V in
Stop 1 mode.
